rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutional, vacating and remanding with a rule that "defendant’s profits" in § 1117(a) cannot be expanded to nonparty affiliates absent joinder or traditional veil-piercing/alter-ego predicates. A few Justices (especially Thomas or Gorsuch) may write separately to emphasize textual limits and due-process/corporate-separateness concerns while agreeing equity still permits tracing and apportionment within the named defendant’s own net profits.
